title: Revenue by customer
prompt: Find total completed-order revenue per customer. Return customer_id, customer_name, total_revenue ordered by customer_id.
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_id

title: Revenue by country and month
prompt: Find completed-order revenue by country and order month. Return country, order_month, revenue ordered by country and order_month.
expected_sql: SELECT c.country, strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS order_month, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country, strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) ORDER BY c.country, order_month

title: Top products by revenue
prompt: Find the top 3 products by item revenue. Return product_id, product_name, revenue ordered by revenue descending, product_id ascending.
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 3

title: Orders without successful payment
prompt: Find orders that do not have a successful payment. Return order_id ordered by order_id.
expected_sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id AND p.status = 'success' WHERE p.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY o.order_id

title: Consecutive login users
prompt: Find users who logged in on consecutive calendar days at least once. Return user_id ordered by user_id.
expected_sql: WITH login_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, date(login_time) AS login_date FROM logins), marked AS (SELECT user_id, login_date, LAG(login_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY login_date) AS prev_date FROM login_days) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM marked WHERE julianday(login_date) - julianday(prev_date) = 1 ORDER BY user_id

title: Running total per customer
prompt: For completed orders, calculate running revenue per customer. Return customer_id, order_id, order_date, amount, running_revenue ordered by customer_id and order_date.
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' ORDER BY customer_id, order_date, order_id

title: Current product price
prompt: Find the current price for each product based on the latest effective_date. Return product_id, price ordered by product_id.
expected_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT product_id, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY effective_date DESC) AS rn FROM product_prices) SELECT product_id, price FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY product_id

title: Inventory day-over-day change
prompt: Calculate day-over-day inventory quantity change per product. Return product_id, snapshot_date, quantity, quantity_change ordered by product_id and snapshot_date.
expected_sql: SELECT product_id, snapshot_date, quantity, quantity - LAG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY snapshot_date) AS quantity_change FROM inventory ORDER BY product_id, snapshot_date

title: Out of stock products
prompt: Find product/date combinations where inventory quantity is zero. Return product_id, snapshot_date ordered by product_id and snapshot_date.
expected_sql: SELECT product_id, snapshot_date FROM inventory WHERE quantity = 0 ORDER BY product_id, snapshot_date

title: Latest failed job runs
prompt: Find jobs whose latest run failed. Return job_id ordered by job_id.
expected_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT job_id, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_id ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn FROM job_runs) SELECT job_id FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'failed' ORDER BY job_id

title: Users with signup and purchase
prompt: Find users who performed both signup and purchase events. Return user_id ordered by user_id.
expected_sql: SELECT user_id FROM events GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN event_name = 'signup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY user_id

title: Monthly active subscribers
prompt: For months 2026-01 through 2026-05, count active subscribers at any point in each month. Return month, active_subscribers ordered by month.
expected_sql: WITH months(month_start) AS (VALUES ('2026-01-01'), ('2026-02-01'), ('2026-03-01'), ('2026-04-01'), ('2026-05-01')) SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', month_start) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS active_subscribers FROM months m JOIN subscriptions s ON s.start_date < date(m.month_start, '+1 month') AND COALESCE(s.end_date, '9999-12-31') >= m.month_start GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY month_start

title: Valid purchase funnel
prompt: Find users who completed view_product, add_to_cart, and purchase in that order. Return user_id ordered by user_id.
expected_sql: WITH steps AS (SELECT user_id, MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_product' THEN event_time END) AS viewed_at FROM events GROUP BY user_id), carts AS (SELECT e.user_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS carted_at FROM events e JOIN steps s ON e.user_id = s.user_id WHERE e.event_name = 'add_to_cart' AND e.event_time > s.viewed_at GROUP BY e.user_id), purchases AS (SELECT e.user_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS purchased_at FROM events e JOIN carts c ON e.user_id = c.user_id WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase' AND e.event_time > c.carted_at GROUP BY e.user_id) SELECT user_id FROM purchases ORDER BY user_id

title: SCD current record validation
prompt: Find customer_ids that do not have exactly one current dimension record. Return customer_id, current_record_count ordered by customer_id.
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_record_count FROM customer_dim GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_current = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <> 1 ORDER BY customer_id

title: Currency conversion
prompt: Convert completed order amounts to USD using the latest exchange rate on or before order_date. Return order_id, amount_usd ordered by order_id.
expected_sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.amount * er.usd_rate AS amount_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.order_id ORDER BY er.rate_date DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN exchange_rates er ON o.currency = er.currency AND er.rate_date <= o.order_date WHERE o.status = 'completed') SELECT order_id, ROUND(amount_usd, 2) AS amount_usd FROM matched WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY order_id
